reason: The GUI shows a catch-up card when a conversation is reopened, quotes an answer into the composer, and opens supporting-evidence and turn-details panels; the terminal had none of these. The terminal now reads Core's catch-up route when a chat opens (silently starting this device's read cursor on a first visit, else a short 'While you were away' summary), and adds /catchup (review or mark read), /quote, /evidence and /turn over Core's catch-up, read-cursor, evidence and turn-summary routes. Selected: the new reading unit suite against Core's documented shapes, the shell and TUI suites (open path, command dispatch and command text), the client wheel allowlist, a real-Core PTY journey on a paired TLS LAN Core (silent first visit, catch-up after another client's turn, mark read, turn details, evidence, quote and send), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, and the settings-catalog terminal test.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and settings catalog keywords changed, and the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. tests/test_terminal_pty.py and tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py are not selected because several of them fail identically on pristine origin/main; they were run locally against a merge of the round-2 terminal branches and against pristine origin/main; the same tests failed on both, apart from two intermittent ones described in the PR (one of which also fails intermittently on main). No live provider calls or Core deployment.
